title: The Purpose
tagline: Turn video insights into action. Earn NFTs, join group challenges & win crypto from Monthly  Pool
description:
The Purpose is a self-growth game powered by AI and Web3. Users pick any inspiring YouTube video, and our AI transforms it into a 7-level transformation journey-  from reflection and real-life action to group collaboration and public sharing.

At Level 5, users pay a fee to enter a team challenge. If their group completes all 7 levels, each validated user earns a NFT that grants access to a monthly staking Reward pool.

Monthly Reward Pool:

✦ Each calendar month, a staking pool is created from user payments.

✦ Completing Level 7 and earning an NFT makes a user eligible for that month’s pool.

✦ Winning chance is calculated per group — the more validated NFT holders in a group, the higher the group's chance to win.

✦ When a group wins, the reward is equally shared among all NFT holders in that group.
how_its_made:
The Purpose We3 (dApp) designed for personal growth and collaborative achievement, leveraging blockchain technology.
Users begin with authentication and wallet creation via Privi,
then proceed to input YouTube links.
The system processes these links to provide personalized AI coaching through a 7-level gamified experience.
Crucially, each level's progress is stored on-chain, ensuring immutable records of user achievement and fostering transparency. This on-chain approach extends to the core of the platform's incentive structure.

A significant component is the Staking Mechanism, which activates at Level 5.

✦ Users pay a fixed fiat or crypto $11 entry fee,

with 50% of payment added to a monthly staking pool, and the remainder allocated to platform operations.
The UI transparently displays the current pool size and the number of active teams.
Upon completing Level 7 and team validation, users can mint a NFT,
which acts as an 'Access Pass to Monthly Prize Pool.'

This NFT is transferable and can be sold as 'Access Pass to Monthly Prize Pool.'
bringing ability to monetize user achievement and granting access to rewards.

The system calculates and displays each team's chance to win based on on-chain metrics,
such as the percentage of team members who reached Level 7 and the number of NFTs held by the group.

Monthly draw determines the winning team, with prizes distributed equally among NFT-holding members.
The frontend provides clear UI for claiming rewards or encouraging continued engagement for non-winning teams.
